findings.text: The added test cannot fail if the guard's named-run branch regresses: it writes the run's live pointer into the same directory `_list_live_records(project=...)` enumerates, so a guard that ignored `run_id` and fell back to inference would produce the identical refusal `promotion dry run refused run <run_id>` and the test would stay green. To pin the branch, assert the refusal only the named-run path can emit, e.g. `crew merge --run <run-id-not-at-head>` answering `run ... is not at head ...; nothing was moved or pushed`.

tests/test_merge_requires_promotable_run.py is outside the run's fenced write paths (the prompt's FENCE — SCOPE lists the three source modules, the evidence fragment and the figures directory, and no test path); the done_when authorises 'the new test', which does not cover editing an existing test file.

justifications.durability: tests/test_merge_requires_promotable_run.py:272 asserts a refusal that reckon/crew/merge.py:151's inference branch emits identically, so removing the `[runs.read_pointer(run_id)]` branch at reckon/crew/merge.py:150 would leave the test green.
justifications.evidence: The gate logs each open with their revision, tree, literal command and imported module and close on a bare EXIT= line, but the negative control's mutation is applied only inside test_merge_refuses_unpromotable_head, so tests/test_merge_requires_promotable_run.py:272 is never falsified by it.
justifications.fit: The new test follows the module's existing fixture pattern (tmp_path checkout, _write_json pointer, CliRunner invoke) and introduces no plan, sprint or version label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/merge.py:186 refuses the merge for a head whose promotion dry run would not promote, and the pre-existing tests at tests/test_merge_requires_promotable_run.py:17 and :164 exercise that on the inference and named-run paths.
justifications.reuse: No production definition is added; the test reuses pointer_path, _write_json, git and _write_origin_and_checkout and exercises the existing guard rather than forking it.
justifications.scope_discipline: Every changed path is a test or evidence file, but tests/test_merge_requires_promotable_run.py is not among the reviewed run's FENCE — SCOPE paths printed in its prompt.txt.
